  state=S0 & in=1 -> S1
| state=S0 & in=0 -> S0
| state=S1 & in=1 -> S2
| state=S1 & in=0 -> S0
| state=S2 & in=1 -> S3

| state=S4 & in=1 -> S5

p = state=S5 ? 1 : 0
